title: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: full-bleed title-screen landscape plate for Làng Sao Mai, an original Vietnamese cozy farming and school RPG. Wide 16:9 composition, designed to reduce cleanly to 320x180. Spring dawn: dusty lavender-to-peach sky with one little morning star, layered blue mountains, green foothills, a small rural Vietnamese village to the right with terracotta roofs, light plaster, shutters, rice plots and a curving cream dirt lane. Dominant landmark on the right third, quiet low-detail dark green meadow on left half below y=40% for menu, open soft sky across top center for logo. Hand-placed 16-bit pixel aesthetic, confident large opaque color clusters, controlled warm light from top left, crisp edges, near-black warm outline accents. Flat orthographic panorama, no photorealism, no 3D, no lettering, no interface, no logo, no watermark. Landscape only.
farm: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one isolated four-object prop sheet with actual transparent alpha, for Làng Sao Mai's spring farm. Square canvas, four equally sized quadrants, objects completely isolated, center each at its quadrant center with generous transparent margin all around and well away from crossing the quadrant boundaries. Top left: inviting rural Vietnamese farmhouse, terracotta tiled roof, cream limewashed walls, dark teal shutters, visible front entry. Top right: single lush rounded Vietnamese fruit tree, amber trunk visible, green sunlit crown. Bottom left: a small grouping of three mossy warm gray stones. Bottom right: a low wooden shipping chest with dark iron clasp. Same top-down three-quarter camera, visible tops and front faces, straight axes, no isometric diamonds. 16-bit cozy farming RPG pixel art, chunky simple clusters, warm golden light from upper left, clear brown ink accents and restrained spring green, warm sandstone and terracotta. No cast shadows, no ground, no other props, no layout marks, no labels, no text, no borders, no watermark. True transparent background.
portrait: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one dialogue portrait for Dì Năm of Làng Sao Mai, original Vietnamese cozy farming and school RPG. Vietnamese middle-aged aunt and village shopkeeper who hands the hero their first farm keys. Front-facing shoulders and head with warm welcoming smile, expressive dark eyes, black hair tied back, terracotta áo bà ba over a soft cream undershirt, one simple small gold earring. Image remains clearly legible when reduced to a 48x48 portrait. 16-bit pixel art with chunky clean clusters and restrained warm palette, no dithering, warm top-left dawn lighting, readable chest-up silhouette, no text, no border, no props. Centered with space around head and shoulders. True transparent background.
